mapper.sql: a.nspname AS schema_name, b.relname AS object_name, CASE b.relkind WHEN 'r' THEN 'TABLE' WHEN 'p' THEN 'PARTITIONED_TABLE' WHEN 'v' THEN 'VIEW' WHEN 'm' THEN 'MATERIALIZED_VIEW' WHEN 'f' THEN 'FOREIGN_TABLE' END AS object_type, pg_catalog.obj_description(b.oid, 'pg_class') AS comment
FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace a INNER JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class b ON b.relnamespace = a.oid
b.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm', 'f') AND NOT b.relispartition AND a.nspname != 'information_schema' AND a.nspname !~ '^pg_'
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE
AND ( b.relname ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(pg_catalog.obj_description(b.oid, 'pg_class'), '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute c WHERE c.attrelid = b.oid AND c.attnum > 0 AND NOT c.attisdropped AND ( c.attname ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(pg_catalog.col_description(b.oid, c.attnum), '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ) )
ORDER BY a.nspname, b.relname LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.attnum AS position, c.attname AS column_name, pg_catalog.format_type(c.atttypid, c.atttypmod) AS data_type, NOT c.attnotnull AS nullable, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint e WHERE e.conrelid = b.oid AND e.contype = 'p' AND c.attnum = ANY (e.conkey) ) AS primary_key, pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid) AS default_value, pg_catalog.col_description(b.oid, c.attnum) AS comment FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace a INNER JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class b ON b.relnamespace = a.oid INNER JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute c ON c.attrelid = b.oid LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid = b.oid AND d.adnum = c.attnum WHERE AND a.nspname = #{schemaName} AND b.relname = #{objectName} AND c.attnum > 0 AND NOT c.attisdropped ORDER BY c.attnum
